title: The Hidden Giant
hook: You've been told the wrong mountain is the tallest on Earth.
script: You've been told the wrong mountain is the tallest on Earth. We usually measure peaks from sea level, which gives Everest the crown. But what if you measured from the true base? Mauna Kea in Hawaii starts six thousand metres below the Pacific surface. This makes its total height over 10,000 metres. If you placed it on the same plateau as Everest, it would tower over the Himalayas by more than a kilometer. The mountain is so heavy it actually pushes the ocean floor downward. Its summit is so high that clouds stay below it, making the air transparent for telescopes. Send this to the friend who still thinks Everest is the tallest.
